title: Random Mob Armor
description: A data pack makes mob equipped armor randomly.
body:
# Random Mob Armor

Load this datapack to give various hostile mobs random armor and weapons, greatly enhancing the challenge and fun of the game!

## 🎯 Features

- **Smart Equipment System**: Supports 14 different types of monsters automatically wearing random armor and weapons
- **Balanced Probability Mechanism**: Uses a multi-layer probability system with 50% armor equip rate, 30% shield possession rate, and 15% left-handed probability
- **Rich Equipment Library**: Contains various weapon and armor combinations from wooden gear to netherite
- **Multiple Monster Support**: Includes zombies, skeletons, drowned, husks, bogged, and other hostile creatures

## 📋 Supported Mobs

- Zombie
- Skeleton
- Drowned
- Husk
- Bogged
- Parched
- Piglin Brute
- Pillager
- Stray
- Vindicator
- Wither Skeleton
- Zombie Villager
- Piglin
- Zombified Piglin

## ⚙️ Technical Features

- Advanced predicate system for probability checks
- Optimized function call structure ensuring smooth gameplay
- Special turtle helmet mechanism for drowned
- Trident off-hand weapon system for aquatic mobs

## 🛠️ Installation

1. Place the datapack into your world save's `datapacks` folder
2. Restart the game and enable the datapack
3. Start enjoying a more challenging survival experience!
